5afa5d327d944e29:ja.source:
Options: `--seed <n>` (default 71), `--port <n>` (default 47820, or `0` for ephemeral),
`--shock <district:metric:delta@round>` or `--no-shock`, `--engine <dir>`,
`--forge <dir>`, `--unresolved-ai-profile <fail|warn>` (default `fail`;
`--release` selects `warn` and forwards `--sidecar-stderr=<log>` to Godot),
`--godot <bin>` (Godot executable path, default `GODOT_BIN` or `godot`),
`--headless` (start the sim only, print the port, and wait),
`--stage-headless` (launch Godot with `--headless` and closed stdin alongside
the sim), and `--quit-after-sync <path>` (pass `--quit-after-sync=<path>` to
Godot so `Playable` writes a JSON sync summary after attach and baseline
snapshot, detaches, and exits `0`). Notice a release-exported Godot stage never spawns the sim directly (it only attaches via `--attach`):
`fail` vs `warn` comes from `tools/play.mjs` (`--release`), `tools/sidecar_harness.gd`
(`OS.is_debug_build()`), or CI's explicit `--unresolved-ai-profile fail`.
5afa5d327d944e29:ja.translation: オプション：`--seed <n>`（既定値 71）、`--port <n>`（既定値 47820、エフェメラルポートの場合は `0`）、`--shock <district:metric:delta@round>` または `--no-shock`、`--engine <dir>`、`--forge <dir>`、`--unresolved-ai-profile <fail|warn>`（既定値 `fail`。`--release` を指定すると `warn` を選択し、`--sidecar-stderr=<log>` を Godot に渡します）、`--godot <bin>`（Godot 実行ファイルのパス。既定値は `GODOT_BIN` または `godot`）、`--headless`（シミュレーションのみを起動し、ポートを表示して待機します）、`--stage-headless`（シミュレーションと並行して、`--headless` と閉じた標準入力で Godot を起動します）、`--quit-after-sync <path>`（`--quit-after-sync=<path>` を Godot に渡し、`Playable` がアタッチとベースラインスナップショットの後に JSON の同期サマリーを書き込み、切断して `0` で終了します）。リリース用にエクスポートされた Godot ステージはシミュレーションを直接起動せず、`--attach` で接続するだけです。`fail` と `warn` のどちらを使うかは、`tools/play.mjs`（`--release`）、`tools/sidecar_harness.gd`（`OS.is_debug_build()`）、または CI が明示的に渡す `--unresolved-ai-profile fail` で決まります。

bed9701593e11846:es.source:
**Errors.** Transport faults, refused connections, handshake version mismatches,
staleness, and halted sync caps are reported as plain sentences on the status
line and in the log (`[stale] state drift at tick N: expected X, mirror Y, first
differing pre-image offset K (resync 1/3)`), never as raw exceptions in the UI.
Godot's own `--verbose` flag turns on engine-level logging; nothing the stage
logs contains a secret because it never holds one.
bed9701593e11846:es.translation:
**Errores.** Los fallos de transporte, las conexiones rechazadas, las discrepancias en la versión del protocolo de enlace, la antigüedad y los límites de sincronización interrumpidos se informan como frases sencillas en la línea de estado y en el registro (`[stale] state drift at tick N: expected X, mirror Y, first
differing pre-image offset K (resync 1/3)`), nunca como excepciones sin procesar en la interfaz de usuario. La bandera `--verbose` de Godot activa el registro a nivel de motor; nada de lo que registra la etapa contiene un secreto porque nunca lo almacena.

f630cbabd51ff818:fr.source:
**CI triggers and path filters.** GitHub Actions gates runs on watched project
paths (`project.godot`, `client/**`, `stage/**`, `tools/**`, `tests/**`,
`fixtures/**`, `entities/**`, `transitions/**`, `assets/**`, `.github/workflows/**`,
`.github/upstream-pins.env`, `atlas/**`) and skips `pull_request` jobs from
same-repository branches because the matching `push` run tests that commit.
Because `on.push.paths` inspects only the pushed range (`before..after`) while
`on.pull_request.paths` inspects the whole PR diff (`base...head`), a same-repo
PR with earlier watched commits leaves its tip SHA without a `headless` run
after either (1) an unwatched-only follow-up commit (`README.md`,
`CHANGELOG.md`, `site/**`, docs) or (2) a commit-message-only or unwatched-only
`--amend` force-push — the watched edits already ran on push, run again on
merge to `main` (`main^..main`), or can be run via `workflow_dispatch`. On
`main`, job concurrency keeps one running job plus at most one pending job
(`cancel-in-progress: false`), so two quick merges both run while a third merge
before the first finishes supersedes the queued second whose tree it includes.
f630cbabd51ff818:fr.translation:
**Déclencheurs CI et filtres de chemin.** GitHub Actions déclenche des exécutions sur les chemins de projet surveillés (`project.godot`, `client/**`, `stage/**`, `tools/**`, `tests/**`, `fixtures/**`, `entities/**`, `transitions/**`, `assets/**`, `.github/workflows/**`, `.github/upstream-pins.env`, `atlas/**`) et ignore `pull_request` tâches provenant des branches du même dépôt, car les tests correspondants (`push`) qui effectuent un commit sont déjà exécutés.
Étant donné que `on.push.paths` n’examine que la plage envoyée (`before..after`), tandis que `on.pull_request.paths` examine l’ensemble des différences de la demande de fusion (`base...head`), une demande de fusion du même dépôt avec des commits surveillés antérieurs laisse son dernier SHA sans exécution `headless` après soit (1) un commit de suivi qui n’est pas surveillé (`README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `site/**`, docs), soit (2) un simple commit ou un commit qui n’est pas surveillé avec une poussée forcée `--amend`. Les modifications surveillées ont déjà été exécutées lors de la poussée, elles sont exécutées à nouveau lors de la fusion vers `main` (`main^..main`), ou peuvent être exécutées via `workflow_dispatch`. Sur `main`, la concurrence des tâches maintient une tâche en cours d’exécution et au maximum une tâche en attente (`cancel-in-progress: false`), de sorte que deux fusions rapides s’exécutent toutes les deux, tandis qu’une troisième fusion avant la fin de la première remplace la deuxième tâche en attente, dont elle inclut l’arborescence.

f630cbabd51ff818:pt.translation:
**Gatilhos de CI e filtros de caminho.** GitHub As ações iniciam execuções nos caminhos de projeto monitorados (`project.godot`, `client/**`, `stage/**`, `tools/**`, `tests/**`, `fixtures/**`, `entities/**`, `transitions/**`, `assets/**`, `.github/workflows/**`, `.github/upstream-pins.env`, `atlas/**`) e ignoram `pull_request` tarefas de ramos do mesmo repositório porque os testes correspondentes `push` são executados ao fazer o commit.
Como `on.push.paths` inspeciona apenas o intervalo enviado (`before..after`), enquanto `on.pull_request.paths` inspeciona toda a diferença do PR (`base...head`), um PR do mesmo repositório com commits monitorados anteriores deixa seu SHA no final sem uma execução `headless` após (1) um commit de acompanhamento que não foi monitorado (`README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `site/**`, docs) ou (2) um envio forçado `--amend` que contém apenas a mensagem do commit ou que não foi monitorado — as edições monitoradas já foram executadas no envio, são executadas novamente na mesclagem para `main` (`main^..main`) ou podem ser executadas por meio de `workflow_dispatch`. Em `main`, a concorrência de tarefas mantém uma tarefa em execução mais, no máximo, uma tarefa pendente (`cancel-in-progress: false`), portanto, duas mesclagens rápidas são executadas simultaneamente, enquanto uma terceira mesclagem antes que a primeira termine substitui a segunda, que estava na fila e cujo árvore está incluída.
